Hey Product Hunt! I'm Stefan, the maker of Keytones, a Mac menubar app.  
  
I developed Keytones because I kept having trouble typing capital letters without realizing it. Keytones addresses this problem: It plays a different sound for uppercase letters, lowercase letters, the space bar, and the modifier keys (all customizable), so your ears will notice an accidentally activated Caps Lock key or an unpressed Shift key sooner than your eyes will.  
  
What makes it different from "typewriter sound" apps:  
  
Keytones isn't about imitating a mechanical keyboard. Each of the four key groups gets its own tone. You hear the difference between A and a immediately.  
  
Key features: [...] Shape the sound for each key group with four knobs: Pitch, Length, Damping, Volume
 Visual Feedback: A glowing border around the screen pulses with each keystroke, with the color and size varying depending on the key group. Can be turned on or off independently of keypress sounds. Ideal for environments where keypress sounds are disruptive or the audio output device has too much latency.
 Per-app control: exclude apps or allow only the ones you pick
 Import your own audio files via drag & drop
 Instant mute: triple-tap a configurable modifier key (Right Command by default)
 Siri & Shortcuts support
 Remembers separate volume levels per audio device (MacBook speakers, headphones, Bluetooth)  
    
  One-time purchase, no subscriptions, no ads!

Version 1.0 (July 21, 2026) · macOS 15.6 or later

Download on the Mac App Store  Keytones - Distinct key sounds for uppercase, lowercase & more | Product Hunt Keytones - Distinct key sounds for uppercase, lowercase & more | Product Hunt

# Customizable key sounds and visual feedback while typing for Mac [...] Keytones is a menu bar app that helps you type by providing auditory and visual feedback. Unlike most mechanical keyboards or typewriter simulators, Keytones distinguishes between uppercase and lowercase letters, allowing you to differentiate them by ear while typing. This feature makes it easier to notice a stray Caps Lock or a Shift key that you didn’t quite hit, preventing you from missing it until three sentences later.

You are free to shape how it all sounds. Adjust pitch, length, damping and volume for each key group, mix the built in sounds, or drag your own audio files in and let Keytones check every import for you. [...] The everyday details are taken care of as well. You can turn off Keytones instantly with a triple tap of a modifier key of your choice, keep it out of the apps where it does not belong by blacklisting them (there is also a whitelist mode), and control it by voice through Siri or from the Shortcuts app. A low latency audio engine keeps your typing smooth and stays crackle free even when you swap headphones halfway through a sentence. And if you are not typing, no CPU cycles are wasted, avoiding battery drain.

macOS 15.6 or later, one time purchase, no subscription, on the Mac App Store.

## Features

Type with confidence

Each key group has its own distinct sound, so you can tell uppercase from lowercase by ear and catch a stray Caps Lock before it wrecks your sentence.
